digo_source: Pakia (2005) App. III, App. VI, main text

teaser.en: A miniature 'palm' a hand's breadth tall whose leaflets fold down when touched.
teaser.sw: 'Mnazi' mdogo mno wenye urefu wa kiganja, ambao vijani vyake hujikunja chini ukiviguswa.
teaser.dg: Mmea mdide dza 'muhi wa jamii ya mnazi', urewe ni dza upana wa fumba, na makodzage madide ganadzikundza photsi uchiuguta.

summary.en: Mbodzembodze is a tiny herb with a rosette of feathery leaves that fold down when touched. Digo people give the same name to the sensitive plant, Mimosa pudica.
summary.sw: Mbodzembodze ni mmea mdogo sana wenye shada la majani kama manyoya yanayojikunja chini yakiguswa. Wadigo hulitoa jina hilohilo kwa kifauongo, Mimosa pudica.
summary.dg: *Mbodzembodze* ni mmea mdide sana wenye fungu ra makodza dza manyoya, ganayodzikundza photsi uchiuguta. Adigo anapha dzina hiri hiri mmea wanjina, *Mimosa pudica*, unaoihwa kpwa Chingereza *sensitive plant*.

about.en: Mbodzembodze is a small annual herb, often only 5 to 15 cm tall. A single slender stem carries a crown of pinnate leaves at the top, so the plant looks like a tiny palm tree. Each leaf has many pairs of small leaflets. When touched, the leaflets fold downwards, and they open again after a while. Small yellow to orange flowers sit on thin stalks among the leaves. They are followed by small capsules.
about.sw: Mbodzembodze ni mmea mdogo wa msimu mmoja, mara nyingi wenye urefu wa sentimita 5 hadi 15 tu. Shina moja jembamba hubeba taji la majani ya mchanganyiko juu kabisa, kwa hivyo mmea huonekana kama mnazi mdogo sana. Kila jani lina jozi nyingi za vijani vidogo. Vikiguswa, vijani hujikunja kuelekea chini, na hufunguka tena baada ya muda. Maua madogo ya manjano hadi machungwa hukaa juu ya vikonyo vyembamba katikati ya majani. Hufuatwa na vibuyu vidogo.
about.dg: *Mbodzembodze* ni mmea mdide unaokala na moyo kpwa mwaka mmwenga tu, na mara nyinji urewe ni sentimita 5 hadi 15 tu. Kolo rimwenga rembamba rinatsukula fungu ra makodza dzulu, na chila kodza rina makodza madide kanda mbiri za mongo wa kodza, kpwa hivyo mmea unaonekana dza muhi mdide sana wa jamii ya mnazi. Chila kodza rina makodza madide manji mairi-mairi. Uchigaguta, makodza madide ganadzikundza photsi, na bada ya muda ganadzivugula tsona. Maruwa madide ga rangi ya mandano hadi rangi ya chungbwa ganakala dzulu ya milita myembamba kahi ya makodza. Maruwa higo ganalavya makakaya madide.

where.en: It grows in shady, damp places: forest floors and edges, shaded bush, and among grass in the rainy season.
where.sw: Hukua mahali penye kivuli na unyevu: sakafuni na pembezoni mwa misitu, vichakani kivulini, na katikati ya nyasi wakati wa mvua.
where.dg: Unamera phatu pha pepho na phenye chinemi: photsi tsakani na kanda-kanda ya matsaka, weruni phenye pepho, na kahi ya nyasi wakati wa mvula.

culture.en: Pakia describes how Digo people identify this herb by its 'desiccation habit', the closing of its leaves on touch, confirmed by touching the plant. He uses it to illustrate the Digo expression *kuvwala nguo*, 'to dress', for a plant that closes its leaves when touched. *Mbodzembodze* is one of the few Digo names that brings together species scientists keep apart. It covers both this plant and *Mimosa pudica*.
culture.sw: Pakia anaeleza jinsi Wadigo wanavyoutambua mmea huu mdogo kwa 'tabia yake ya kujikunja', yaani kufunga majani yake ukiguswa, jambo linalothibitishwa kwa kuugusa. Anautumia kufafanua msemo wa Kidigo *kuvwala nguo*, 'kuvaa nguo', kwa mmea unaofunga majani yake ukiguswa. *Mbodzembodze* ni mojawapo ya majina machache ya Kidigo yanayounganisha spishi ambazo wanasayansi huzitenganisha. Linajumuisha mmea huu na *Mimosa pudica*.
culture.dg: Pakia anaeleza vira Adigo anavyoumanya mmea hinyu kpwa chitu anachochiiha *desiccation habit*, yani makodzage kudzikundza uchiuguta; atu nkuhakikisha kpwa kuuguta mmea. Anauhumira kuonyesa maneno ga Chidigo *kuvwala nguo*, 'kuvwala nguwo', ganayohumirwa kpwa mmea unaokundza makodzage uchigutwa. *Mbodzembodze* ni mwenga kahi ya madzina machache ga Chidigo ganayoika phamwenga aina ambazo asayansi anaziganya. Dzina hiri rinahumirwa kpwa mmea hinyu na piya kpwa *Mimosa pudica*.

names.en: Digo: *mbodzembodze*, shared with Duruma according to Pakia, who gives no meaning. Pakia lists *Mimosa pudica* as *mbodzebodze*, and in his main text he treats this as the same name for all leaf-folding plants. No English or Swahili name is recorded. Related species are sometimes called little tree plants.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mbodzembodze*, jina linaloshirikiwa na Kiduruma kwa mujibu wa Pakia, ambaye hatoi maana yake. Pakia anaorodhesha *Mimosa pudica* kama *mbodzebodze*, na katika maandishi yake makuu analichukulia hili kuwa jina lilelile kwa mimea yote inayojikunja majani. Hakuna jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa. Spishi zinazohusiana wakati mwingine huitwa *little tree plants*.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo ni *mbodzembodze*. Pakia anagomba kukala Aduruma nao anahumira dzina hiri, ela kapha manage. Pakia anaandika *Mimosa pudica* dza *mbodzebodze*, na mwakpwe chitabuni anarihumira dzina hiri kpwa mimea yosi inayokundza makodzage. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili wala ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa. Aina zanjina za phephi wakati wanjina nkuihwa *little tree plants*.

reason.en: Phyllanthus amarus, another tiny herb with small paired leaflets
reason.sw: Phyllanthus amarus, mmea mwingine mdogo sana wenye vijani vidogo vilivyo kwa jozi
reason.dg: *Phyllanthus amarus*, mmea wanjina mdide sana wenye makodza madide mairi-mairi

reason.en: Another small herb of the ground layer
reason.sw: Mmea mwingine mdogo wa tabaka la chini
reason.dg: Mmea wanjina mdide unaomera photsi, photsi ya mimea mikulu
